name: Heriot-Watt University

facts.text: Heriot-Watt's story began in Edinburgh in 1821 as the world's first mechanics institute.
Heriot-Watt has campuses in Edinburgh (postcode EH14 4AS, Riccarton), the Scottish Borders, Orkney, Dubai and Malaysia, plus online study.
Heriot-Watt describes itself as 'a specialist, pioneering University, with a global presence, world renowned, innovative research and highly employable graduates.'
REF 2021 ranked 86.8% of Heriot-Watt's research as world-leading and internationally excellent.
The Watt Club, founded in 1854, is the UK's oldest graduate club.
